successCriteria.description: AuditRecord entity interface exists at src/modules/audit/audit.model.ts with exact fields: id, entityType, entityId, action (AuditAction), oldValues (Record<string, unknown> | null), newValues (Record<string, unknown> | null), performedBy, performedAt, ipAddress (string | null), userAgent (string | null), createdAt. Imports AuditAction from 'shared/types/audit-action.enum'.

IAuditRepository interface extends IBaseRepository<AuditRecord> and declares findByEntity(entityType: string, entityId: string), findByPerformedBy(performedBy: string), and findByDateRange(startDate: Date, endDate: Date). AuditRepository class extends BaseRepository<AuditRecord> with tableName = 'audit_logs' and implements all methods using snake_case column mappings.

IAuditService interface declares log(entry: Omit<AuditRecord, 'id' | 'createdAt'>): Promise<AuditRecord>, getAuditTrail(entityType: string, entityId: string): Promise<AuditRecord[]>, and getByEntity(entityType: string, entityId: string): Promise<AuditRecord[]>. AuditService implementation delegates to IAuditRepository and throws NotFoundError when getAuditTrail/getByEntity find no records.

Notification entity interface exists at src/modules/notification/notification.model.ts with exact fields: id, recipientId, type (NotificationType), title, message, relatedEntityType (string | null), relatedEntityId (string | null), status ('UNREAD' | 'READ'), createdAt, readAt (Date | null). Imports NotificationType from 'shared/types/notification-type.enum'.

INotificationRepository interface extends IBaseRepository<Notification> and declares findByRecipient(recipientId: string), findUnreadByRecipient(recipientId: string), and markAsRead(id: string). NotificationRepository class extends BaseRepository<Notification> with tableName = 'notifications' and implements all methods using snake_case column mappings.

INotificationService interface declares send(dto: { recipientId: string; type: NotificationType; title: string; message: string; relatedEntityType?: string; relatedEntityId?: string }): Promise<Notification>, getNotifications(recipientId: string): Promise<Notification[]>, markAsRead(id: string): Promise<Notification>, and markAllAsRead(recipientId: string): Promise<number>. NotificationService implementation delegates to INotificationRepository.

Barrel exports at src/modules/audit/index.ts re-export the model interface, repository interface + class, and service interface + class. Barrel exports at src/modules/notification/index.ts re-export the model interface, repository interface + class, and service interface + class.

All 8 new files compile without type errors when the project is built (npm run build). No file imports from another module's internals — all cross-module imports go through index.ts barrel exports or shared/ paths.

constraints: All database access must go through the repository layer — no inline SQL in services. AuditRepository and NotificationRepository must extend BaseRepository and use the shared pg Pool.

Repository methods must accept an optional PoolClient parameter for transaction support, matching the pattern in IBaseRepository and all existing repository implementations (EmployeeRepository, LeaveBalanceRepository, LeaveRequestRepository).

SQL column names must use snake_case with the exact mappings: entityType→entity_type, entityId→entity_id, oldValues→old_values, newValues→new_values, performedBy→performed_by, performedAt→performed_at, ipAddress→ip_address, userAgent→user_agent, createdAt→created_at, recipientId→recipient_id, relatedEntityType→related_entity_type, relatedEntityId→related_entity_id, readAt→read_at.

No controllers, routes, or HTTP handlers in this sub-phase. The audit and notification modules are model + repository + service + barrel only, matching the Phase 2–3 pattern (Employee, LeavePolicy, LeaveBalance) before controllers were added in Phase 4.
No test files in this sub-phase. Unit and integration tests are owned by sibling sub-phase 5.3.
outOfScope: Controllers, routes, and HTTP handlers for audit or notification modules — these modules are model + repository + service only in this sub-phase.
Unit tests or integration tests for audit or notification modules — tests are owned by sibling sub-phase 5.3.

Wiring audit logging into LeaveRequestService or any other existing service — audit record creation on state-changing operations is a future integration concern. This sub-phase builds the audit module's capability; callers will use it later.
Registration of any routes in src/app.ts — app wiring is owned by sibling sub-phase 5.2.

entityInvariants.invariant: AuditRecord is immutable once created — the repository must not expose update or delete operations that modify existing audit records. The IAuditRepository inherits update/delete from IBaseRepository but callers must treat audit records as append-only; the service layer must never call update/delete on audit records.

Notification status transitions are: UNREAD → READ (via markAsRead). Once READ, a notification must not transition back to UNREAD. The markAsRead repository method must set status = 'READ' and readAt = NOW().

interfaceConstraints.authRule: No auth enforcement at this layer — auth is a controller/middleware concern. The performedBy parameter is caller-supplied.
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Must not throw on valid input. If the underlying repository create fails (e.g. DB error), the error propagates unmodified.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: No auth enforcement at this layer.
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Must create a Notification with status = 'UNREAD', createdAt = new Date(), readAt = null. Must not throw on valid input.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: No auth enforcement at this layer.
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Must throw NotFoundError if the notification does not exist. If already READ, must return the notification unchanged (idempotent — no error).

interfaceConstraints.authRule: No auth enforcement at this layer.
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Must update all UNREAD notifications for the given recipientId to READ with readAt = NOW(). Returns the count of notifications updated. If none are UNREAD, returns 0 (idempotent — no error).

consistencyRequirements.requirement: AuditRepository and NotificationRepository must extend BaseRepository<T> from 'shared/base-repository' and follow the exact same pattern as EmployeeRepository and LeaveBalanceRepository: protected readonly tableName, constructor accepting optional Pool override, all custom query methods using `const executor = client ?? this.pool` for transaction support.

Service implementations must follow the "throw on not found" pattern established by EmployeeService and LeaveRequestService: getById/getAuditTrail/getByEntity/getNotifications throw NotFoundError when the repository returns null/empty. The constructor injects the repository interface, not the concrete class.

Barrel exports must follow the exact pattern of existing modules: export the model interface, export the repository interface AND class, export the service interface AND class. No controller or routes exports (those don't exist yet for these modules).
Services must import and use NotFoundError, ValidationError from 'shared/error-types' — the same error classes used by all existing services. No new error classes or ad-hoc error throwing.

integrationPoints.why: AuditRecord.model imports AuditAction; Notification.model imports NotificationType. Both enums already exist and are re-exported from the shared types barrel.
Both AuditRepository and NotificationRepository extend BaseRepository and implement IBaseRepository. This is the foundation for all repository classes in the project.

AuditService.getAuditTrail/getByEntity throw NotFoundError when no records found. NotificationService.markAsRead throws NotFoundError for nonexistent notification. These are the same error classes used by all existing services.
Both repository classes use the shared pg Pool via BaseRepository's constructor, which defaults to the pool exported from connection.ts.
